Question ID: ANP_U05_L04_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.CRI.02

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Heart Sounds, Hypertension, and Circulatory Evidence
Stimulus: BP/heart case stimulus

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, identify chambers, valves, and circulation pathway. Then use the required stimulus (BP/heart case stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to heart anatomy, heart sounds, hypertension, and evidence. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.CRI.02 and avoids the common mistake: thinking heart sounds come from muscle squeezing.
